title: A collectible lookup answer or error is applied to whichever lookup is open, not the one that asked
trigger: Tap a collectible username/phone row on profile A, then before the answer arrives tap one on profile B (second tap replaces hub.collectible and sends a second request). A's answer (or COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND) lands.
effect: The box for B shows A's purchase date and price under B's name and owner; or A's not-found error marks B failed, so B's link is copied and its real answer is dropped. Applies by purpose only (state/domains/payments/apply.rs:25, error.rs:64); CollectibleLookup holds no request id.
fix: Make the lookup an enum Loading{request: RequestId} / Ready(info) / Failed(reason) and apply an answer or error only when its extra equals the Loading request id.

title: CollectibleLookup stage is loading: bool + info: Option + failed: Option kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a collectible box; the answer sets loading=false and info, an error sets loading=false and failed.
effect: Today all three can be set together or none (request lost leaves loading=true so a repeat tap on the same entity returns Ok(None) and never re-sends; request_collectible_info in connect/payments.rs:293 checks open.loading).
fix: Fetch<CollectibleInfo> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the request id in the loading variant.

title: Calls 'Clear all' stage is recent_calls_clearing: bool beside recent_calls_request and recent_calls_error
trigger: Open the Calls tab, press Clear all, confirm; while in flight the button hides via can_clear(len, clearing).
effect: Stage is a bool set after send (connect/calls/history.rs:190) and cleared by hand in session_apply_ok.rs:63 and calls/error.rs:92, not matched to the request id; fetch_call_history can clear the list while clearing is true. No bug found today.
fix: One enum for the recent-calls list: Idle/Loading{request}/Ready/Failed/Clearing{request}; can_clear takes the enum.

title: Pasted clipboard images are written to a guessable world-readable temp file that is never deleted
trigger: Paste an image into the composer (or export a peer QR through the same helper), send or discard it, keep using Quill.
effect: The image bytes stay in the system temp dir as quill-paste-<nanos>-<seq>-<pid>.<ext> (default umask, usually readable by other local users) until the OS clears temp; the startup sweep in scratch.rs only covers the quill-send-photos/quill-edits... subfolders, not these files. A guessable name in a shared temp dir is also open to a pre-placed symlink.
fix: Write into the swept per-process work dir (scratch) with create_new and mode 0600, and delete the file when the tray entry is sent, removed or the app exits.

title: A deferred caption for a pending media message is never dropped if the pending message is deleted or cancelled
trigger: Send a photo, press Up to edit the caption while it is uploading, then delete/cancel the pending message so no updateMessageSendSucceeded or Failed arrives for it.
effect: The DeferredCaption stays in session.messages.deferred_captions for the life of the account (only run_deferred_caption on a send outcome removes it). Small leak; no wrong send since temp ids are not reused.
fix: Drop deferred captions in the message-delete reducer, or keep the caption on the pending message row as a PendingSend::CaptionEdited variant so it dies with the row.

title: Birthday suggestion dismissal is an optimistic birthdays_hidden bool reverted by hand
trigger: Dismiss the birthday card: connect/privacy_data.rs:255 sets birthdays_hidden=true after sending; HideContactCloseBirthdays error resets it (session_privacy_data.rs:182); updateContactCloseBirthdays resets it (settings/apply.rs:262).
effect: Works today, but the stage (shown / hiding / hidden) is a bool plus a reset rule in three places, not matched to the dismiss request.
fix: enum BirthdayCard {Shown, Hiding{request}, Hidden} and apply the error only for that request id.

title: A released swipe re-resolves its action when it fires, so a chat state change in the 150 ms spring-back flips the action
trigger: Swipe a row past the threshold with Mute configured while the chat is unmuted, release; another device (or a sync) mutes the chat within 150 ms.
effect: poll() returns only the chat id; chat_swipe_ui.rs:290 perform_swipe_action recomputes the label from current facts, so the action run is Unmute while the panel showed Mute. Tiny window.
fix: Store the resolved SwipeLabel in Release and fire exactly that action.

title: SwipeMachine holds gesture: Option and releases: Vec plus per-gesture direction_set/reached bools
trigger: Trackpad swipe on a chat row.
effect: Explicit machine, tested; Gesture uses direction_set + orientation + reached bools stepped by hand, and the app keeps a poll: Option<Task> as a 'timer running' flag (ui/chat_swipe_ui.rs:36). No bug found: state lives in OnScreen.chat_list and its task is spawn_screen.
fix: Fold direction_set into Orientation::Undecided{no_direction}/..., and make the poll task part of the machine state.
